scope: Original TechnoClass::ReceiveDamage scatter-tail gates (0x702B47..0x702D0B) on the accepted and refused retaliation arms: Foot flag, MissionControl Scatter, tether, Walk Is_Moving, Target, NavCom, WhatAmI, house control, PlayerScatter and rank abilities, with the Scatter call arguments. No Scatter body, RNG, destination or full damage parity claim.
assumptions: Supplied Infantry/Unit/Aircraft/Building buffers with original vtables, AbstractFlags, type, house, rank float and Walk interface state; current Guard uses an explicit MissionControl Scatter byte.
Target/NavCom nonnull sentinels are compared only, never dereferenced.
The ShouldRetaliate answer selects the entry; the Scatter call is observed at 0x702D0B and not executed.
